sections.title: The problem
sections.body:
Many children start English with grammar drills and grow up associating it with fear of mistakes. Parents want early English exposure, but good, warm, play-based classes are hard to find and expensive.

Bloomly makes the first years of English joyful.

items.title: Play-based classes
items.description: Games, songs, and storytelling for children, grouped by age.

items.title: Parent guides
items.description: Simple activities parents can do at home to keep English alive between classes.

items.title: Holiday programs
items.description: Short themed English camps during school holidays.

sections.body: Children who join Bloomly speak up in English earlier and with less hesitation, which is exactly the habit we want to build.
